Titel: Freelance Power BI Developer (Microsoft Fabric) - 100% Remote
Unternehmen: Tidewater Data Collective B.V.
Ort: Netherlands (Remote)
Quelle: LinkedIn
Link: https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/4316540982/
Abgerufen am: 21.09.2026 07:32

About the job
Tidewater Data Collective is a boutique data consultancy based in Utrecht. We help retailers and wholesalers across the Benelux and DACH region turn their data into decisions.

For a large wholesale client we are looking for a hands-on Power BI Developer who can start on short notice. You will join a scrum team of 6 (data engineers, analytics engineer, product owner) that migrates the existing Power BI Premium landscape to Microsoft Fabric.

What you will do
- Build and optimize semantic models (star schema, DAX, calculation groups, RLS)
- Rebuild ~40 legacy reports in Power BI following the new design system
- Develop dataflows gen2 and Power Query (M) transformations
- Work with our data engineers on the Fabric Lakehouse (Delta tables, PySpark notebooks)
- Set up deployment pipelines and Git integration with Azure DevOps
- Performance tuning (DAX Studio, Tabular Editor)

What you bring
- 4+ years of hands-on Power BI development in an enterprise environment
- Excellent DAX and data modelling skills
- Experience with Microsoft Fabric or Azure Synapse
- Certifications PL-300 and/or DP-600 are a plus
- Fluent English, Dutch is a strong plus
- You are an independent contractor (ZZP / freelancer) with your own company

Details
- Start: 05.10.2026
- Duration: 4 months, likely extension
- 32 hours per week, fully remote within CET +/- 1h
- Rate: EUR 70 - 85 per hour

Seniority level
Mid-Senior level
